portInfo.description: Jacksonville Port Authority operates a dedicated cruise terminal at 9810 August Drive with cruise contact (904) 357-3006. Berth #10 is published at 1,289 feet (393 m) length, 40 feet (12.2 m) depth along mean low water, deck height 9 feet (2.7 m) above mean sea level, 80-foot-wide apron, no published maximum beam, and 15.3 nautical miles from the sea buoy. Terminal building figures: 63,000 sq ft overall, 28,000 sq ft baggage handling, 15,000 sq ft passenger embarkation. Parking is on-site adjacent to the terminal without reservations; payment is credit-card only at published daily rates. Large-vessel entry follows St. Johns Bar Pilot Association procedures per JAXPORT.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Organised beach or city transfer — ~180 min with traffic buffer.
Terminal-area time — limited independent walk attractions at the industrial Dames Point setting.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Use 9810 August Drive in navigation apps — JAXPORT’s corporate Talleyrand Avenue HQ is a different facility.
